title: A2A lifecycle settings and declared raw user configuration
description: The document root validates lifecycle settings after core consumes dial policy and resource labels from /agents/*. Unstamped older shapes are judged by the native migration parser. The raw entry point describes the canonical a2a deployment section; its format-2 pin is a mechanism string. Migration returns dial facts inside registration CONFIG, never an UPSTREAM fragment.

resource.description: Optional opaque core-owned policy label. Null and absence are unbound. Canonical host admission additionally enforces at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; JSON Schema maxLength counts characters. Core strips this field before lifecycle validation and preserves its exact authored value on writeback.

url.description: Core-owned network endpoint; canonical host admission validates URL syntax and transport policy.

client_identity.description: One raw SecretRef for the certificate-chain and private-key PEM bundle; core validates and resolves the reference.

tls.description: Core-owned TLS grammar. Canonical admission validates pins, CA material, identity references and endpoint compatibility.

auth.description: Core-owned outbound binding: an auth instance name or one bearer, api_key, token_exchange or connection form with optional cache_max_s. Canonical host admission validates the selected form and raw SecretRefs.

upstream_credentials.description: Core validates credential-mode and binding compatibility; schema acceptance grants no credential forwarding authority.

authored_settings.description: Native settings bag for the a2a alias. The registration declaration /agents/* is relative to this bag. Core injects public_url into lifecycle settings; author the host public_url instead.

x-busbar-user-configuration.settings_representation: Canonical raw format-2 settings under the native a2a alias; /agents/* identifies registrations inside that bag. Lifecycle settings exclude core-owned dial fields and resource labels.
runtime_validation: Run the canonical host validate/apply path: declaration splitting, core URL/TLS/auth/SecretRef/credential/private-reach validation, resource UTF-8 byte validation, then lifecycle schema/check/open.
The host owns source fences, exact core-field reattachment, migration LIFT authorization and publication; an installed schema does not prove activation.
Unstamped 1.5.5 input requires native migration. Legacy pin objects are not the canonical authored registration grammar.
This declaration requires the admitted native descriptor to be projected into the host configuration schema publisher with a2a section ownership.
